title: Taiwan Plans Record Defense Budget to Counter China, Report Says
content:
• Taiwan plans to spend a record NT$1.1 trillion on its military in 2027.
• The defense budget for 2027 is projected to exceed 3% of GDP.
• For the first time, Taiwan's initial military budget for this year included funds for the coast guard and veteran pensions.

title: Petrol, diesel prices today: How costly is fuel in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru as crude oil rises on elusive Iran-Oman deal
content:
• The last major price revision by state-owned fuel retailers (OMCs) in India occurred on May 25.
• Before the onset of the West Asia war, the Strait of Hormuz carried a fifth of the world's oil.
• Iran stated it would not engage in talks with the US as long as Washington breaches an interim deal signed in June.

title: Trump prepares to declare Iran war victory if Hormuz reopens, willing to walk away without nuclear deal: Report
content:
• The Strait of Hormuz has become Iran's strongest source of leverage since the conflict began in February, with its disruption impacting global oil markets and commercial traffic.
• The average US gasoline price was $4.02 a gallon on Saturday, according to AAA, compared with $3.16 a year earlier, highlighting the economic impact of regional tensions.
• US President Donald Trump has shifted his focus from a comprehensive nuclear deal to ensuring the full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, while Iran demands billions of dollars in US payments, sanctions lifted, and frozen assets released as conditions.

title: Indian national arrested in Germany after allegedly strangling girlfriend in Arizona and fleeing US: Report
content:
• Indian national Varun Batchigari, 20, was arrested in Germany, facing charges of first-degree murder and kidnapping after allegedly killing his 19-year-old girlfriend, Julissa Rubi Salazar, in Tucson, Arizona.
• Julissa Rubi Salazar was found dead on August 6, and investigators allege Batchigari used her bank cards to pay for transportation before fleeing from Tucson, Arizona, to Germany.
• Batchigari's arrest in Germany was made with assistance from the FBI’s Tucson office and the FBI Legal Attaché Office in Berlin, and he is currently awaiting extradition to the US.

title: RBI governor flagged banks' margin stress, and banks see it continuing
content:
• The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee maintained the key policy repo rate at 5.25% at its meeting last week.
• State Bank of India (SBI) chairman C.S. Setty maintained the bank's Net Interest Margin (NIM) guidance of 3% for FY27, after posting 2.86% for the June quarter, as stated on August 6.
• Large private lenders such as HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank have hiked interest rates on their Foreign Currency Non-Resident (FCNR(B)) deposits, now offering up to 6.25% return.

title: RBI survey sees stronger FY27 growth, higher inflation; FY28 outlook points to ‘Goldilocks’ economy
content:
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI), in its monthly monetary policy review on August 5, revised India's FY27 real GDP growth forecast upwards by 10 basis points to 6.7% and lowered its retail inflation projection by 10 basis points to 5%.
• India's Current Account Deficit (CAD) for FY27 is now expected to narrow significantly to 1.4% of GDP, compared with an earlier projection of 2.1%, and for FY28, it is estimated at 1.1% of GDP.
• RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra, in his monetary policy statement on August 5, reaffirmed India's position as the world's fastest-growing major economy.

title: GOBARdhan Scheme can help reduce gas imports by $5 billion, says IBA
content:
• The government's GOBARdhan (Galvanising Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan) Scheme has a financial outlay of ₹23,731 crore.
• The GOBARdhan Scheme is expected to reduce India's gas import bill by $5 billion, according to the Indian Biogas Association (IBA).
• With an estimated 1500 functional CBG plants, the GOBARdhan Scheme can reduce the fertiliser import bill by $1 billion (5% of FY 24-25's $18 billion bill), contributing to the Current Account Deficit reduction.

title: Housing scheme for SC/ST communitieson the anvil: Kerala CM
content:
• Kerala Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan announced a new housing scheme for Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST) communities on Sunday, August 9, 2026.
• Directions have been issued to the Finance department to ensure e-grants for SC/ST students, and a new service portal was inaugurated for speed and transparency in services rendered by the Department of SC/ST Welfare.
• During the State-level inauguration of the International Day of the World’s Indigenous Peoples on August 9, 2026, it was stated that there are 48 crore indigenous people globally.

title: Coimbatore-based industrialist honoured
content:
• Coimbatore-based industrialist Nandini Rangaswamy, Managing Director of Chandra Group, was honoured at an awards event.
• Nandini Rangaswamy received an award under the Business and Education category at the Sakthi Masala’s SuyaSakthi Virudhugal – Homepreneur Awards 2026.
• Applications for the awards were shortlisted by the Centre for Research, Entrepreneurship & Social Technology (CREST), IIT Madras, and winners were selected across nine award categories by a 25-member expert jury.

title: Nagarjunasagar all geared up to host Varuna Yagam seeking abundant rains on Monday (August 10)
content:
• The Telangana government is conducting a Varuna Yagam at Nagarjunasagar on Monday, August 10, with Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy participating and Irrigation Minister N. Uttam Kumar Reddy leading the program.
• Nagarjunasagar reservoir has a gross storage capacity of 312.045 TMC and a full reservoir level (FRL) of 590 feet.
• As of August 10, Nagarjunasagar currently holds only 145.65 TMC of water with a level of about 518 feet, compared to approximately 310.25 TMC held on the same date last year.
